questions.prompt: Few students would __________ to question the professor in front of the whole class.
questions.explanation: 语法上，would 后接动词原形，所以填 dare。语义上，在全班面前质疑教授需要“敢于”做某事。常见搭配：dare to do something。

questions.prompt: A lack of confidence can become a serious __________ to learning a new language.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和形容词 serious，后面需要可数名词单数。语义上，缺乏自信会成为学习新语言的“障碍”。常见搭配：a barrier to something。

questions.prompt: The new software helps users __________ their computers of unwanted files.
questions.explanation: 语法上，helps users 后可接动词原形，结构为 help someone do something。语义上，软件帮助用户“清除/摆脱”不需要的文件。常见搭配：rid something of something。

questions.prompt: Their parents’ __________ had a deep effect on the children’s daily lives.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面是所有格 Their parents’，后面需要名词。语义上，父母“离婚”会影响孩子日常生活。

questions.prompt: Heavy rain may __________ the outdoor concert if the stage is not protected.
questions.explanation: 语法上，may 后接动词原形。语义上，大雨可能“毁掉”户外音乐会。常见搭配：ruin a plan / event / chance。

questions.prompt: The villagers decided to __________ the old coins under a large tree.
questions.explanation: 语法上，decided to 后接动词原形。语义上，村民决定把旧硬币“埋”在树下。

questions.prompt: You should seek professional __________ before making such a major legal decision.
questions.explanation: 语法上，professional 修饰名词，所以填 counsel。语义上，重大法律决定前应寻求专业“建议/法律意见”。常见搭配：seek legal/professional counsel。

questions.prompt: Teenagers often have a __________ to compare themselves with others online.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a，后面有不定式 to compare，需要名词。语义上，青少年常有与他人比较的“倾向”。常见搭配：have a tendency to do something。

questions.prompt: There are __________ delays on this road during the morning rush hour.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 delays，需要形容词。语义上，早高峰这条路经常出现延误，所以填“频繁的”。

questions.prompt: The boat’s __________ stopped suddenly in the middle of the lake.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面是所有格 The boat’s，后面需要名词。语义上，船在湖中突然停下，是因为“发动机/马达”停止工作。

questions.prompt: Clean drinking water is necessary for human __________ in extreme conditions.
questions.explanation: 语法上，for human 后需要名词。语义上，在极端环境中，干净饮用水对人类“生存”是必要的。常见搭配：human survival。

questions.prompt: The speaker tried to __________ the criticism with clear evidence.
questions.explanation: 语法上，tried to 后接动词原形。语义上，演讲者用证据“反驳”批评。常见搭配：counter an argument / criticism。

questions.prompt: Students are not allowed to leave early without their teacher’s __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，所有格 their teacher’s 后需要名词。语义上，学生没有老师“许可”不能提前离开。常见搭配：without permission。

questions.prompt: The village lies in a quiet __________ between two high mountains.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和形容词 quiet，需要可数名词单数。语义上，村庄位于两座高山之间的“山谷”。

questions.prompt: Some insects can __________ on the surface of water without sinking.
questions.explanation: 语法上，can 后接动词原形。语义上，一些昆虫能在水面“漂浮”而不下沉。常见搭配：float on the surface of water。

questions.prompt: My brother was __________ when he found out that I had used his bike.
questions.explanation: 语法上，was 后接形容词作表语。语义上，发现别人用了自己的自行车后感到“生气”。常见搭配：be mad at someone / be mad about something。

questions.prompt: Better lighting has __________ improved safety in the underground station.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰动词 improved，需要副词。语义上，更好的照明“极大地”提高了地铁站安全性。常见搭配：greatly improve / reduce / increase。

questions.prompt: The warning sign is clearly __________ from the other side of the road.
questions.explanation: 语法上，is 后接形容词作表语。语义上，警示牌从路对面也“可见”。常见搭配：be visible from somewhere。

questions.prompt: Many families now drive __________ cars to reduce fuel costs.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 cars，需要形容词。语义上，许多家庭开“电动”汽车来降低燃油成本。常见搭配：electric car。

questions.prompt: To join the club, members must __________ a valid student card.
questions.explanation: 语法上，must 后接动词原形。语义上，加入俱乐部的成员必须“拥有”有效学生证。常见搭配：possess a card / skill / quality。

questions.prompt: Her speech was so __________ that even the judges stood up to applaud.
questions.explanation: 语法上，was so 后接形容词。语义上，演讲非常“令人印象深刻”，以至于评委起立鼓掌。

questions.prompt: Scientists study the __________ of animals to understand how species change over time.
questions.explanation: 语法上，冠词 the 后需要名词。语义上，科学家研究动物“进化”以理解物种如何随时间变化。

questions.prompt: The campaign aims to raise public __________ of online safety.
questions.explanation: 语法上，raise public 后需要名词。语义上，活动旨在提升公众对网络安全的“意识”。常见搭配：raise awareness of/about something。

questions.prompt: The police warned people to stay away from the __________ crowd.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 crowd，需要形容词。语义上，警方警告人们远离“暴力的”人群。

questions.prompt: In the past, a __________ could be bought and sold like property.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a，后面需要可数名词单数。语义上，过去“奴隶”可能像财产一样被买卖。

questions.prompt: The museum was built with money donated by a __________ businessman.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 businessman，需要形容词。语义上，博物馆由一位“富有的”商人捐款建造。

questions.prompt: The city is famous for its modern __________ and unusual building designs.
questions.explanation: 语法上，介词 for 后需要名词。语义上，城市因现代“建筑风格/建筑设计”而出名。

questions.prompt: Being ten minutes late is not __________ for such an important interview.
questions.explanation: 语法上，is not 后接形容词。语义上，这么重要的面试迟到十分钟是“不可接受的”。

questions.prompt: The scientist published her findings in a medical __________ last month.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和形容词 medical，需要名词。语义上，科学家把发现发表在医学“期刊”上。常见搭配：a medical/scientific journal。

questions.prompt: Many factories used to burn __________ to produce energy.
questions.explanation: 语法上，burn 后接名词作宾语。语义上，许多工厂过去燃烧“煤”来生产能源。

questions.prompt: Accurate __________ is important when scientists record the growth of plants.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 Accurate 后需要名词。语义上，科学家记录植物生长时，准确“测量”很重要。

questions.prompt: The teacher chose three students at __________ to answer the questions.
questions.explanation: 语法上，介词短语 at random 是固定表达。语义上，老师随机选择三名学生回答问题。常见搭配：at random。

questions.prompt: After months of practice, she __________ passed the driving test.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰动词 passed，需要副词。语义上，她经过数月练习后“成功地”通过驾照考试。

questions.prompt: Too much bad news can __________ young people and make them feel hopeless.
questions.explanation: 语法上，can 后接动词原形。语义上，过多负面新闻会“使年轻人沮丧”。常见搭配：depress someone。

questions.prompt: The diagram gives a clear __________ of how the machine works.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和形容词 clear，需要名词。语义上，图示清楚“说明”机器如何运作。

questions.prompt: The balloon may __________ if you blow too much air into it.
questions.explanation: 语法上，may 后接动词原形。语义上，气球充入太多空气可能会“爆裂”。

questions.prompt: Studying abroad is still a __________ that not every family can afford.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a，后面有定语从句，空格需要名词。语义上，出国留学仍是并非所有家庭都能负担的“特权”。

questions.prompt: The __________ asked several questions before deciding to buy the apartment.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 The，后面谓语是 asked，需要名词作主语。语义上，买公寓前提问的人是“买家”。

questions.prompt: Their business relationship is based on __________ trust and respect.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 trust and respect，需要形容词。语义上，商业关系建立在“相互的”信任和尊重上。常见搭配：mutual trust / respect / understanding。

questions.prompt: Hold the __________ when you walk down the stairs.
questions.explanation: 语法上，the 后需要名词。语义上，下楼梯时应扶着“栏杆”。常见搭配：hold the rail。

questions.prompt: Good teachers can __________ students to keep learning even when work becomes difficult.
questions.explanation: 语法上，can 后接动词原形。语义上，好老师能“激励”学生在困难时继续学习。常见搭配：motivate someone to do something。

questions.prompt: The scientists tested the new medicine in a secure __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，介词 in 后接名词。语义上，科学家在安全的“实验室”测试新药。

questions.prompt: They took out a __________ to buy their first home.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a，需要名词。语义上，他们为购买第一套房申请了“抵押贷款”。常见搭配：take out a mortgage。

questions.prompt: The company offered a special __________ to attract new customers this weekend.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和形容词 special，需要名词。语义上，公司提供特别“促销”来吸引顾客。

questions.prompt: She has a real __________ for painting and spends every evening in her studio.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和形容词 real，需要名词。语义上，她对绘画有真正的“热情”。常见搭配：have a passion for something。

questions.prompt: The young boxer became a national __________ after winning the final match.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和形容词 national，需要名词。语义上，年轻拳击手赢得决赛后成为全国“冠军”。

questions.prompt: We must __________ our promises if we want others to trust us.
questions.explanation: 语法上，must 后接动词原形。语义上，想获得他人信任，就必须“履行”承诺。常见搭配：fulfill a promise / duty / dream。

questions.prompt: The writer decided to __________ his new book to his parents.
questions.explanation: 语法上，decided to 后接动词原形。语义上，作者决定把新书“题献”给父母。常见搭配：dedicate something to someone。

questions.prompt: The shelves were covered with __________ after the house had been empty for months.
questions.explanation: 语法上，介词 with 后接名词。语义上，房子空置数月后，架子上布满“灰尘”。常见搭配：be covered with dust。

questions.prompt: The repair will cost __________ two hundred dollars, depending on the damage.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰数量 two hundred dollars，需要副词。语义上，修理费用“大约”两百美元。常见搭配：roughly two hundred / roughly speaking。

questions.prompt: She wore a black __________ and a white shirt to the school concert.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和形容词 black，需要可数名词单数。语义上，她穿黑色“裙子”和白衬衫去学校音乐会。

questions.prompt: Sichuan is a large __________ in southwest China.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和形容词 large，需要名词。语义上，四川是中国西南的一个大“省”。

questions.prompt: The soldiers had to __________ for hours through the heavy rain.
questions.explanation: 语法上，had to 后接动词原形。语义上，士兵不得不在大雨中“行进”数小时。

questions.prompt: The manager wrote a detailed __________ of each employee’s performance.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和形容词 detailed，需要名词。语义上，经理写了每位员工表现的详细“评估”。常见搭配：performance evaluation。

questions.prompt: Both sides finally reached a __________ after a long discussion.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a，需要名词。语义上，双方经过长时间讨论后达成“妥协”。常见搭配：reach a compromise。

questions.prompt: With careful planning, we can __________ the project before Friday.
questions.explanation: 语法上，can 后接动词原形。语义上，通过周密计划，我们能在周五前“完成”项目。常见搭配：accomplish a task / goal / project。

questions.prompt: His main __________ is that he gives up too quickly under pressure.
questions.explanation: 语法上，所有格 His main 后需要名词。语义上，他主要的“弱点”是在压力下太快放弃。

questions.prompt: The school made an __________ about the new exam rules this morning.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 an，需要以元音音素开头的名词。语义上，学校发布了关于新考试规则的“通知”。常见搭配：make an announcement。

questions.prompt: Add a little __________ to the soup before serving it.
questions.explanation: 语法上，Add a little 后接不可数名词。语义上，上汤前加一点“盐”。

questions.prompt: She took a quick __________ at her watch and hurried out.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和形容词 quick，需要名词。语义上，她快速“瞥了一眼”手表然后匆忙离开。常见搭配：take a quick glance at something。

questions.prompt: My grandmother enjoys listening to Italian __________ on Sunday afternoons.
questions.explanation: 语法上，listening to 后接名词。语义上，奶奶喜欢听意大利“歌剧”。

questions.prompt: The school will hold a writing __________ for students next month.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和名词修饰语 writing，需要名词。语义上，学校下个月要举行写作“比赛”。常见搭配：hold a contest。

questions.prompt: You need a soft __________ to clean the camera lens safely.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和形容词 soft，需要名词。语义上，清洁相机镜头需要软“刷子”。

questions.prompt: Please do not __________ him by laughing at his mistake.
questions.explanation: 语法上，do not 后接动词原形。语义上，不要通过嘲笑他的错误让他“尴尬”。

questions.prompt: The paintings will be shown in a small art __________ downtown.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和形容词短语 small art，需要名词。语义上，画作将在市中心的小型艺术“画廊”展出。常见搭配：art gallery。

questions.prompt: Some diseases are linked to __________ factors passed down from parents.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 factors，需要形容词。语义上，一些疾病与从父母遗传下来的“基因”因素有关。常见搭配：genetic factors。

questions.prompt: The coach told the players not to be too __________ during practice.
questions.explanation: 语法上，be too 后接形容词。语义上，教练告诉球员训练时不要太“好斗”。常见搭配：aggressive behaviour / an aggressive player。

questions.prompt: He felt a sharp pain in his __________ after running too fast.
questions.explanation: 语法上，介词 in 后接名词。语义上，跑太快后他感到“胸部”剧痛。

questions.prompt: The report must follow the correct __________, with clear headings and spacing.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 the correct，需要名词。语义上，报告必须遵循正确“格式”。常见搭配：follow the correct format。

questions.prompt: This course introduces students to modern __________ texts from different countries.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 texts，需要形容词。语义上，课程介绍来自不同国家的现代“文学的”文本。常见搭配：literary texts / literary works。

questions.prompt: Clear laws are needed to __________ how companies collect personal data.
questions.explanation: 语法上，are needed to 后接动词原形。语义上，需要明确法律来“管理/规范”公司如何收集个人数据。常见搭配：govern how / govern the use of something。

questions.prompt: Many young people now __________ online learning as a normal part of education.
questions.explanation: 语法上，主语 Many young people 后需要动词原形作谓语。语义上，许多年轻人现在“接受”在线学习作为教育的正常部分。

questions.prompt: Parents should __________ effort, not only exam results.
questions.explanation: 语法上，should 后接动词原形。语义上，父母应该“赞美”努力，而不只是考试成绩。常见搭配：praise someone for something。

questions.prompt: The room became completely __________ after the head teacher entered.
questions.explanation: 语法上，became completely 后接形容词。语义上，校长进入后房间变得完全“安静”。

questions.prompt: The farmer used a water __________ to move water from the river to the field.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和名词修饰语 water，需要名词。语义上，农民用水“泵”把河水抽到田里。常见搭配：water pump。

questions.prompt: The __________ agreed to print the author’s first novel.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 The，后面谓语是 agreed，需要名词作主语。语义上，同意出版作者第一部小说的是“出版商”。

questions.prompt: The whole town joined the __________ after the team won the championship.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 the，需要名词。语义上，球队夺冠后，全镇都加入“庆祝”。常见搭配：join the celebration。

questions.prompt: He plays __________ every weekend with his colleagues.
questions.explanation: 语法上，plays 后接运动名词。语义上，他每周末和同事打“高尔夫球”。常见搭配：play golf。

questions.prompt: The worker received financial __________ after being injured at work.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 financial 后需要名词。语义上，工人受伤后获得经济“补偿”。常见搭配：receive financial compensation。

questions.prompt: She prefers __________ music to modern pop songs.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 music，需要形容词。语义上，她比起现代流行音乐更喜欢“古典”音乐。常见搭配：classical music。

questions.prompt: You should __________ the advantages and disadvantages before making a decision.
questions.explanation: 语法上，should 后接动词原形。语义上，做决定前应“权衡”优缺点。常见搭配：weigh the advantages and disadvantages。

questions.prompt: The final match is Spain __________ Brazil, and tickets are already sold out.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格连接两个比赛双方 Spain 和 Brazil，需要介词。语义上，决赛是西班牙“对阵”巴西。

questions.prompt: The country faces a large budget __________ after years of heavy spending.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和形容词短语 large budget，需要名词。语义上，多年大量支出后，国家面临严重预算“赤字”。常见搭配：budget deficit。

questions.prompt: We need to __________ the plan because the original schedule is no longer realistic.
questions.explanation: 语法上，need to 后接动词原形。语义上，原计划不现实，所以需要“修改”计划。常见搭配：modify a plan / design / rule。

questions.prompt: A sudden __________ of light appeared in the dark sky.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 A 和形容词 sudden，需要名词。语义上，黑暗天空中出现一阵“闪光”。常见搭配：a flash of light。

questions.prompt: Their __________ became stronger after they travelled together for two weeks.
questions.explanation: 语法上，所有格 Their 后需要名词。语义上，一起旅行两周后，他们的“友谊”更牢固了。

questions.prompt: Medicine is a respected __________ that requires many years of training.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和形容词 respected，需要名词。语义上，医学是需要多年训练的受人尊敬的“职业”。常见搭配：a respected profession。

questions.prompt: I was __________ shaking with fear when the lift suddenly stopped.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰动词短语 was shaking，需要副词。语义上，电梯突然停下时，我“真的/确实”吓得发抖。

questions.prompt: The students solved the __________ by moving all numbers to one side.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 the，需要名词。语义上，学生通过把所有数字移到一边来解“方程式”。常见搭配：solve an equation。

questions.prompt: A simple __________, such as a smile, can make a guest feel welcome.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 A 和形容词 simple，需要名词。语义上，一个微笑这样的简单“动作/表示”能让客人感到受欢迎。

questions.prompt: The magician tried to __________ the children with tricks and funny stories.
questions.explanation: 语法上，tried to 后接动词原形。语义上，魔术师用戏法和有趣故事“娱乐”孩子们。

questions.prompt: The view from the mountain was absolutely __________ at sunset.
questions.explanation: 语法上，was absolutely 后接形容词。语义上，日落时山上的景色“极好的”。常见搭配：absolutely fantastic。

questions.prompt: The teacher will __________ each group a different topic for the presentation.
questions.explanation: 语法上，will 后接动词原形。语义上，老师会给每组“分配”不同的展示主题。常见搭配：assign someone something / assign something to someone。

questions.prompt: High __________ makes food and housing more expensive for ordinary families.
questions.explanation: 语法上，形容词 High 后需要名词。语义上，高“通货膨胀”使普通家庭的食物和住房更贵。

questions.prompt: The signing of the peace agreement was a __________ moment for the country.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 moment，需要形容词。语义上，和平协议的签署对国家来说是“历史性的”时刻。常见搭配：a historic moment / decision / agreement。

questions.prompt: Be careful when lifting heavy boxes, or you may __________ your back.
questions.explanation: 语法上，may 后接动词原形。语义上，搬重箱子不小心可能会“伤到”背部。

questions.prompt: They live in a __________ village far from the nearest hospital.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 village，需要形容词。语义上，他们住在远离最近医院的“偏僻”村庄。常见搭配：a remote village / area。

questions.prompt: Music __________ can help some patients reduce stress and anxiety.
questions.explanation: 语法上，Music 修饰名词，空格需要名词。语义上，音乐“治疗”能帮助一些病人减轻压力和焦虑。常见搭配：music therapy。

questions.prompt: She bought an __________ jacket so drivers could see her clearly at night.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰名词 jacket，需要形容词。语义上，她买了一件“橙色的”夹克，让司机能在夜间清楚看到她。

questions.prompt: The film has a surprising __________ near the end that changes the whole story.
questions.explanation: 语法上，前面有冠词 a 和形容词 surprising，需要名词。语义上，电影接近结尾处有一个令人惊讶的“转折”，改变了整个故事。常见搭配：a surprising twist。
